rendered: The Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes row of Table 1[1] names NMC 811[2]. In the ORNL study, NMC 811[3] cathodes at an areal loading of 2.2 mA h/cm^2[4] kept 80%[5] capacity at a 6C[6] charging rate. The corresponding NMC 532[7] and NMC 622[8] cathodes, at areal loadings of 2.4[9] mA h/cm^2, retained only 49%[10] and 56%[11] capacity, respectively, at 6C[12] rate. So the NMC 811[13] cathode kept the most capacity at that rate.
